summary: Angle bays beside a commercial yard near the station; no homes close.
reasons: Backs onto commercial yard, no homes
Cars park here all the time

drivers.seclusion: Backs onto a commercial yard and shops; nearest mapped dwellings are over 50 m away, with the apartment block across the park on the south side.
drivers.access_and_room: Open angle-parking bays in a turning head; room for a van if it fits the bay length.
drivers.traffic: Beside the railway station and a busy town-centre street, so noisy but not a neighbour concern.
drivers.convention: Several cars parked in the bays in both images; 1P angle Mon-Sat daytime signs, and some No Stopping signs nearby.

flags: No Stopping Any Time signs close by
Noise from the railway and station
sun_shade: Tree shade at the western end; open to sun elsewhere, the shop roofs shade the kerb from the north.
cannot_judge: Whether a 7 m van fits the bay length

best_section.where: Angle bays on the north side of the Lambert Road turning head, next to the station car park
